title: Engineering context and traceability
description: Compose understandable engineering context and explain relationship paths, responsibility gaps, and possible change impact without authoring competing model facts.
responsibilities: Present current definitions and applicable recorded rationale with distinct completeness and applicability outcomes.
Traverse declared relationship scope and derive reverse views from authoritative edges.
Explain allocation gaps and possible impact with the paths and limits supporting the conclusion.
owned_state: Derived presentation and traversal results tied to their source state and scope; no separately authoritative copy of engineering relationships.

includes: Current context presentation, relationship navigation, allocation analysis, and possible-impact reporting.
excludes: Definition mutation, invented rationale, approval judgments, or treating graph reachability as proof of impact or satisfaction.

design_limits: IF-001 supports the IR-001 presentation slice. Traversal and impact interfaces for IR-002 remain deferred.
Rendering technology and delivery surfaces remain undecided; the contract concerns observable meaning and diagnostics.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.
